opening.quote: Good afternoon, Tidewell homes, Ruud speakin. How can I help?
opening.comment: The agent gave the company name and their own first name, which meets the opening requirement.

verification.quote: Fine. Give me the new a dress.
verification.comment: Before changing the order, the agent should have confirmed the caller's full name plus the order number or account postcode, but they went straight to taking the new address and changing the order.

understanding.quote: Right, done, changed order 391827 to 22 lindengrakht.
understanding.comment: The agent captured the address change, but did not clarify the caller's concern about the dispatch email before dismissing it.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Yes, it was dispatched yesterday, but that doesn't matter, the courier will go to the new address.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Address changes are only possible before dispatch, so the agent wrongly promised the change would work after the order had shipped, and the 2 to 4 day timeline was also not confirmed as applicable.

process_compliance.quote: Yes, it was dispatched yesterday, but that doesn't matter, the courier will go to the new address.
process_compliance.comment: The agent should have explained that the address change cannot be made after dispatch rather than making an unsupported promise; no other required steps applied to this call.

communication.quote: I'm really stressed about this, it's urgent.
communication.comment: The caller said they were stressed, and the agent replied with 'Fine' and never acknowledged the stress, which was not polite or empathetic.

closing.comment: The agent closed politely but did not confirm the next steps clearly or ask if there was anything else before ending; the caller had replied 'No' only to a general prompt, and the call ended abruptly.
